journey.name: Time cap
journey.description: Make the Timer a five-minute time cap, tap a few rounds, take one back, lock the screen and hear the cap's end, then see the rounds on the summary and in the Log. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets
Tap the "Work" row and, on its sheet, tap "Time cap: as many rounds as you can"; verify that the Timer shows one "Time cap" row reading 20:00, with no "Rest", "Rounds" or "Sets"
Tap the "Time cap" row, tap the quick pick "5:00", then "Done", and verify that the total reads 5:10
Tap "Start workout" and verify "Get ready", then "Work" with "Round 1" and "0 rounds" under the ring, a big "Round done" button and "Undo" in Back's place, with no "+10s"
Tap "Round done" three times, a few seconds apart, and verify that the count rolls up to "3 rounds" and a line reads "This round" with a time and "a round" with the average
Pull down the notification shade and verify that the workout's notification reads "Work · 2 rounds done" under the clock
Lock the screen and wait for the cap to end, about five minutes; verify that "Time. 2 rounds. Done. Nice work" is heard
Unlock and verify that the summary reads "2 rounds in 5 min" with a line of the average, fastest and slowest round, and "Saved to your log"
Tap "Close", go back to the presets, open the "Log" tab and verify that the workout's row says "2 rounds"; tap it and verify "Rounds in 5 min" reads 2 with "A round" beside it
